|errata_history={{Card errata/Imperial Detention (Virtual Set D)}}
This is the errata version PC-E1 of [[Imperial Detention (Virtual Set D)]] (version 2 of 3). The image here is the Players Committee card image of this version. The current text is [[Imperial Detention (Virtual Set D) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source. Every publication that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026); the printed errata mark counts changes to the words instead, so it can be lower than the version number.
* '''Original''' ([[Imperial Detention (Virtual Set D)]]): Slip in the PC's Virtual Card Master Set (Set 0), official text as of 1 August 2016<ref name="ms2016">Players Committee, Virtual Card Master Set (Set 0) PDF <code>Set-0.pdf</code>, “Official text as of August 1, 2016” (file created 2 August 2016), page 5, slip “•Imperial Detention” ([https://web.archive.org/web/20160806222234/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-0.pdf Internet Archive copy of 6 August 2016]).</ref>: “Plays on table. For opponent to deploy a character, starship, or vehicle for free (except by that card's own game text), opponent must first use 2 Force.” Printed: a full slip (title bar, lore and game text, with a blank area where the picture is), to be laid over the Decipher card; lower-left name “•Restricted Access”; no errata mark. The PC first released this card with [[Virtual Set 0]] / [[Virtual Set D]] on 24 September 2014; the slips of that first release do not survive in the Internet Archive, so this sheet is the earliest surviving text. The PC re-issued the PDF on 30 May 2017 with this slip unchanged (pixel-identical)<ref name="ms2017">The same PDF re-issued by the PC (file created 30 May 2017), page 3 ([https://web.archive.org/web/20170704234722/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-0.pdf Internet Archive copy of 4 July 2017]).</ref>. The PC's full card image of this printing was first published on 8 July 2018<ref name="v1-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/022435b/Images-HT/starwars/ResetDS-Dark/large/imperialdetention.gif imperialdetention.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b 022435b] (8 July 2018, “Set 9 load”).</ref> ([[:File:VD-D-imperialdetention-2018-07-08.gif]]): the slip is the same card render (same frame, typesetting, line breaks and lower-left name) with the picture left blank, with the same words. A same-words slip that reprints a card image is a note on that version, not a separate version (Bill, 17 November 2026).
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): Card image published 31 July 2022<ref name="v2-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/ab74419/Images-HT/starwars/ResetDS-Dark/large/imperialdetention.gif imperialdetention.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/ab74419 ab74419] (31 July 2022, “updated hires gifs”); high-resolution image <code>ResetDS-Dark/hires/imperialdetention.png</code>, commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/594c3a0 594c3a0] (31 July 2022, “Set 0 Hi Res”).</ref>: “Plays on table. For opponent to deploy a character, starship, or vehicle for free (except by that card's own game text), opponent must first use 2 Force.” Printed: no errata mark; lower-left name “Restricted Access”. '''Errata mark:''' this image prints no errata mark but is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026). '''What changed:''' re-rendered by the PC in its high-resolution card style (new frame, colours and typesetting); same words. The bullet is dropped from the lower-left name (“Restricted Access”). No errata mark.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Imperial Detention (Virtual Set D) (Errata 2)]]): Card image published 15 July 2023<ref name="v3-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e898f40/Images-HT/starwars/ResetDS-Dark/large/imperialdetention.gif imperialdetention.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/e898f40 e898f40] (15 July 2023, “Fixing case and making gifs”); high-resolution image <code>ResetDS-Dark/hires/imperialdetention.png</code>, commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/8c75a39 8c75a39] (14 July 2023, “Imperial Detention errata”).</ref>: “Plays on table. For opponent to deploy a character, starship, or vehicle for free (except by that card's own game text), opponent must first use 2 Force. [Jabba's Palace] I Must Be Allowed To Speak may not target locations except Lars' Moisture Farm and Jabba's Palace sites.” Printed: marked “E1”; lower-left name “Restricted Access”. '''Errata mark:''' this image prints “E1”: the first change to the words. '''What changed:''' PC errata of July 2023 (high-resolution image committed 14 July 2023 as “Imperial Detention errata”; image marked “E1”): new last sentence “[Jabba's Palace] I Must Be Allowed To Speak may not target locations except Lars' Moisture Farm and Jabba's Palace sites.” The Reflections III icon at the upper right is removed.
|notes=The later [[Imperial Detention (Virtual Set D) (Errata 2)]] version was cut from Virtual Set D with [[Virtual Set 23]] on 22 July 2024: the July 2024 Defensive Shield Update Kit lists “•Imperial Detention” under “Dark Side – Cut”<ref name="dskit2024">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/DShieldUpdateKit_2024_July.pdf July 2024 Defensive Shield Update Kit] (PDF, 3 pages, “SWCCG Players Committee, July 2024”; file built 2 August 2024), released with [[Virtual Set 23]] (22 July 2024).</ref>, and its anti-free text moved to the new [[A Useless Gesture & •Death Star Sentry]] combo card. A blanked card is treated as if it did not exist from that date (in effect a ban); it is not a new version. It stays in its set and is legal in period formats that end before the blanking.
